raw_html: [[Ghostly|Enhanced Ghostly]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Ghostly|Enhanced Ghostly]]:''' Equipping this item causes you to become partially incorporeal. Your melee attacks do not roll a miss chance for Incorporeal targets. Enemy attacks have a 15% chance to miss you due to [[Incorporeal|incorporeality]]. You receive a +5 [[enhancement bonus]] to your [[Hide]] and [[Move Silently]] skills.
